entries.poseBrief: Lateral three-quarter presentation, RIGHT foot on a small stump and LEFT foot flat, LEFT hand resting on an added green camouflage tactical upper layer over original alien net/armor, RIGHT wrist lowered; keep alien face hidden by original silver mask, body proportions/feet and all original gear.
entries.poseDescription: Lateral three-quarter presentation, RIGHT foot on a small stump and LEFT foot flat, LEFT hand resting on an added green camouflage tactical upper layer over original alien net/armor, RIGHT wrist lowered; keep alien face hidden by original silver mask, body proportions/feet and all original gear.
entries.themeBrief: Exclusive iconic outfit swap: Dutch 1987 green camouflage sleeveless upper shirt/vest layer ONLY, scoped donor source; no gender swap.

notes: Scoped Dutch costume overlay is visible as green camouflage sleeveless upper layer/dark upper webbing over retained net/armor; no human face/skin/anatomy, rifle or grenades imported. Original worn Predator chest charms retained.

Closed opaque classic biomask, black banded tendrils, mottled tan alien body, LEFT caster/armor/computer and RIGHT twin blades remain correctly placed. Both whole clawed feet and both blade tips clear.
Distinct RIGHT foot on stump / LEFT hand at upper-layer hip pose, new high timber river observation platform with valley and jungle beyond in pixel art.
limitations: Film full-figure still obscures feet with foreground; licensed NECA image is a scoped body/feet support only.
Back armor, tiny wrist controls and hidden facial anatomy remain unqualified; frame mostly front/three-quarter and keep computer closed.
CG13 and CG15 are explicit hypothetical fan-art transformations, not film chronology or franchise-canon designs.
Copies are not additional independent sources. Current shared plan/Bible remain untouched until root accepts new dated record.
Exact tiny worn charm arrangement and overlapping wristblade notch profiles are not resolved fully by the local film/licensed images.
